effects.label: Burn
effects.description: Damages the recipient by a percentage of their MAX HP, once per tick, for the duration of the debuff. Creates a Damage Zone around the recipient, damaging any of their allies in the indicated radius by a percentage of their MAX HP every tick.The number of ticks per second increases with Skill Speed. This debuff can be stacked.

levels.text:
Attacks 1 enemy 2 times, dealing 20 damage per hit. Casts a [1% Burn] debuff on the target, lasting 2s, on the second hit. The [Burn] ticks every 2s, damaging targets by 1% of their MAX HP per tick (up to 150% ATK). Also damages all of the target's allies in a 6m radius by 0.5% of their MAX HP per tick (up to 150% ATK).
Accuracy required for: Burn

bio: The volcanos of the Southern Thursians burn with a deadly heat, but for some Orcs that fire is a crucible. Vixara thrives in the flames, and where she flourished, others will do the same. She brings the fires with her in her iron lash, and any who cross her path will be reborn – or perish.
